intent: Count how many of six specified product variants have available_today_quantity >= 1 at the Vienna Praterstern store today.

params.line1: Gardena Smart PowerMax 280-5FI Manual Garden Tool
params.line2: Helios Professional Helios 29A-FTE Metal and Concrete Paint
params.line3: Metabo Brushless BS 1OW-IK5 Cordless Drill Driver
params.line6: Bosch Compact PKS 375-EOK Corded Angle Grinder

success_criteria: Vienna Praterstern store_id resolved from stores table
Each of the 6 products resolved to its specific variant SKU via product_family_name + distinguishing properties
available_today_quantity >= 1 at the resolved store evaluated per product against store_inventory
Count of products with availability returned and rendered as qty=%d
refs cite the record_path of each product counted as available (and no unavailable ones)

args.stdin: SELECT store_id, store_name, city, record_path FROM stores WHERE store_name = :store_name OR record_path LIKE '%praterstern%';

SELECT DISTINCT pp.property_key FROM product_variant_properties pp JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_sku = pp.product_sku JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name IN (:line1, :line2, :line3, :line4, :line5, :line6) ORDER BY pp.property_key;

WITH ts AS (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE store_name = :store_name OR record_path LIKE '%praterstern%'), matched AS (SELECT 1 AS pnum, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :line1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties x WHERE x.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND x.property_key = 'tool_type' AND x.property_value_text = :p1_tool_type) UNION ALL SELECT 2, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :line2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties x WHERE x.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND x.property_key = 'product_type' AND x.property_value_text = :p2_product_type) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties x WHERE x.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND x.property_key = 'color_family' AND x.property_value_text = :p2_color_family) UNION ALL SELECT 3, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :line3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties x WHERE x.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND x.property_key = 'voltage_v' AND x.property_value_text = :p3_voltage_v) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties x WHERE x.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND x.property_key = 'battery_platform' AND x.property_value_text = :p3_battery_platform) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties x WHERE x.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND x.property_key = 'kit_contents' AND x.property_value_text = :p3_kit_contents) UNION ALL SELECT 4, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :line4 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties x WHERE x.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND x.property_key = 'wattage_w' AND x.property_value_text = :p4_wattage_w) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties x WHERE x.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND x.property_key = 'luminous_flux_lm' AND x.property_value_text = :p4_luminous_flux_lm) UNION ALL SELECT 5, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :line5 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties x WHERE x.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND x.property_key = 'size' AND x.property_value_text = :p5_size) UNION ALL SELECT 6, pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id WHERE pf.product_family_name = :line6 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties x WHERE x.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND x.property_key = 'disc_diameter_mm' AND x.property_value_text = :p6_disc_diameter_mm)), avail AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.pnum, m.record_path FROM matched m JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku = m.product_sku JOIN ts ON ts.store_id = si.store_id WHERE si.available_today_quantity >= 1) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pnum) FROM avail) AS qty, (SELECT group_concat(record_path) FROM avail) AS available_paths;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
